dragLag.note: VK-503 Task 16: the gate compares against the dragFollow fit's analytic ramp lag (7.09 pt at 90 pt/s, spec §17.1), not research §4.2's 'about 9 pt'. The 9 pt is one hand-read value from the same trace the fit (rms 0.31 pt) used; the frame strips cannot settle it: native has no finger marker, and the native lens starts its drag 2 to 5 rows (0.1-0.25 s) after Flutter's depending on the driver (idb, XCUITest), so the alignment, not a 2 pt lag difference, dominates.
